query:
UPDATE kanban_tasks SET
            status = $1,
            goal_phase = CASE WHEN $2 = 'blocked' THEN 'blocked' ELSE goal_phase END,
            goal_blocked_code = CASE WHEN $3 = 'blocked'
                THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(goal_blocked_code, ''), 'unspecified')
                ELSE goal_blocked_code END,
            goal_blocked_message = CASE WHEN $4 = 'blocked'
                THEN COALESCE(goal_blocked_message, '')
                ELSE goal_blocked_message END,
            goal_revision = CASE WHEN $5 = 'blocked' THEN goal_revision + 1 ELSE goal_revision END,
            updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE id = $6
